pares.citacao: p.4, Sec.2.1: 'Within this study, Portland cement CEM I 42.5 R was used for the reference cement paste further modified by BFA ... cement was replaced up to 70 wt.% in 10 wt.% steps'; Tabela 3 (p.5)
